description: Nishat Mills Limited is the flagship company of Nishat Group, established in 1951, and describes itself as one of the most modern, largest vertically integrated textile companies in Pakistan. It is engaged in textile manufacturing — spinning, combing, weaving, bleaching, dyeing, printing, stitching and apparel — and in buying, selling and dealing in yarn, linen, cloth and other fabrics made from raw cotton and synthetic fibre, as well as in generating, distributing, supplying and selling electricity.

products.name: Spinning — yarn
products.summary: Ring-spun cotton and blended yarns, with 251,808 spindles and 7,320 rotors across seven spinning units and a capacity of 270 tons per day.

products.name: Weaving — fabric
products.summary: 931 air jet looms producing approximately 30 million square metres of cotton and poly cotton fabric per month.

products.name: Processing — finished fabric
products.summary: Fabric processing with capacity for 104 million metres of fabric per annum, handling twills, drills, canvases, poplins and stretch fabrics.

products.name: Home textile
products.summary: Quilt covers, valances, quilted throw-overs, flat and fitted sheets, baby sets, table linen, curtains and pillow cases, made in two stitching facilities.

products.name: Garments
products.summary: Men's and women's garment manufacturing with capacity of 14.40 million garments per annum.

products.name: Captive power generation
products.summary: Captive co-generation power plants supplying in-house energy requirements at its spinning, weaving, processing, stitching and apparel units.
